description: Create a new bulk message campaign to send messages to multiple contacts. Messages can be targeted by label. Campaign will be scheduled and processed by the queue.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to create and dispatch this bulk campaign to every matching contact.

label_ids.description: Array of label IDs to target. Contacts with these labels will receive the message.

send_now.description: Whether to dispatch immediately (true) or schedule for later (false). Default: false — a campaign must be dispatched explicitly.

sending_date.description: Scheduled date/time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm format. Required if send_now is false.

window_ack.description: Required (true) when this workspace sends through an official WhatsApp Cloud API number: this campaign is free-form text, which Meta delivers ONLY to contacts who messaged the business in the last 24 hours (everyone else fails with error 131047). Pass true only after telling the user that. To reach everyone, use an approved template campaign in LetsBot instead.

name: create_campaign
